enableAtlasTree.label: Keep the Atlas passive tree
enableAtlasTree.description: Off, as in Legacy of Phrecia: Idols replace the Atlas passive tree, which the client hides. On: the Atlas passive tree stays usable beside the Idols.

dropRate.label: Idol drop rate
dropRate.description: How many times as often monsters in maps drop Idols. 0 stops them dropping.
